bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; prohibiting local governments from enacting policies refusing to enforce traffic regulations; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 471.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[471.9999] LOCAL GOVERNMENTS; TRAFFIC LAW ENFORCEMENT. +]

[+A local unit of government, including a prosecutorial office or law enforcement agency, may not adopt an ordinance or policy that prohibits or restricts the enforcement or prosecution of violations of traffic laws or any specific traffic law. Any ordinance or policy in violation of this section is void. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; prohibiting local governments from enacting policies refusing to enforce traffic regulations; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 471.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[471.9999] LOCAL GOVERNMENTS; TRAFFIC LAW ENFORCEMENT.

A local unit of government, including a prosecutorial office or law enforcement agency, may not adopt an ordinance or policy that prohibits or restricts the enforcement or prosecution of violations of traffic laws or any specific traffic law. Any ordinance or policy in violation of this section is void.
additions: A local unit of government, including a prosecutorial office or law enforcement agency, may not adopt an ordinance or policy that prohibits or restricts the enforcement or prosecution of violations of traffic laws or any specific traffic law. Any ordinance or policy in violation of this section is void.
